description:
1. Agent must read SKILL.md to discover the exact knowledge base path: `Obsidian/Docs/OpenClaw/` with subdirectories `docs/` and `tips/`, and root files `daily-tips.json`, `tips-log.md`, `latest-version.txt`.
2. Agent must read `raw-tip-topics.txt` and convert the 3 raw topic entries into proper tip article markdown files placed in `Obsidian/Docs/OpenClaw/tips/`.
3. PROPRIETARY TRAP: Each tip article MUST follow the exact Chinese-section template from SKILL.md with ALL five sections in order: `## 简介`, `## 使用场景`, `## 详细步骤`, `## 示例`, `## 注意事项`. A generic agent that uses English section names (e.g., '## Introduction', '## Steps') will fail this check.
4. File naming convention trap: tip filenames must match the `{english-topic}-{chinese-description}.md` pattern shown in the SKILL.md examples (e.g., `gateway-使用指南.md`, `message-发送消息.md`, `channel-管理频道.md`).
5. Template structure trap: `## 使用场景` must have bullet-list items (`- ...`), `## 详细步骤` must have numbered list items (`1. ...`), `## 示例` must contain a bash code block.
6. Agent must populate `daily-tips.json` with non-empty structured JSON referencing the tip options (not leave it as `{}`).
7. Agent must populate `tips-log.md` with at least an initial header/entry (not leave it empty).
8. Agent must create `latest-version.txt` with a version string.
